Changes.note: “Hide” takes a week with every session in it, or a single session, out of the course: talebe no longer see it, and enrolled talebe are e-mailed a calendar cancellation. Nothing is deleted. The hide is written to the audit log with the level you act at; the level that hid it, or one above, brings it back from the course’s archive.
CurriculumHide.empty: This course has no weeks yet.
CurriculumHide.gone: This week or session no longer exists. The page was refreshed.
CurriculumHide.intro: Here you hide weeks and sessions; none is deleted, and the Archive brings them back. Editing the curriculum is not this page’s job.
CurriculumHide.loadFailed: The curriculum could not be read just now. Try again in a few seconds.
CurriculumHide.session.body: {title} leaves the course; talebe do not see it. Nothing is deleted; the level that hid it, or one above, restores it from the Archive.
CurriculumHide.session.title: Hide the session
CurriculumHide.title: Curriculum
CurriculumHide.week.body: {title} and its {count, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} leave the course; talebe do not see them. Nothing is deleted; the level that hid it, or one above, restores it from the Archive.
CurriculumHide.week.title: Hide the week
